contract: Add the supplied official Trust emblem to the Trust introduction only. See contract.md.

accessibility.evidence: DOM exposes the meaningful emblem alternative text after the introduction; image is not in the tab order. Keyboard Tab focuses Home and Menu with a visible 3px outline. No new interactive controls or motion added.

responsive.evidence: Reviewed all four saved screenshots. Heading, introduction, full transparent logo and story fit without overlap; logo sits right on desktop/tablet and below text on mobile. No document horizontal overflow; one main heading; image loaded in every viewport.

loading.reason: No new application loading state or async content source: the existing bundled image uses intrinsic width/height to reserve space.

empty.reason: The required brand image is a bundled asset, with no optional collection or empty variant.

error.reason: No new data source or error handler; this change is limited to rendering a supplied static image. Image loading was verified, but simulated network failure was not exercised.

partial.reason: No new partial-data branch; existing CMS introduction and Trust content rendering are unchanged.

success.evidence: Official Trust emblem loaded and remained legible in the first viewport on desktop, tablet and mobile.

permission.reason: This is an existing public brand asset already authorised by the client; no access controls or new permission boundary.

renderedEvidence.observation: Official mark sits to the right of the original heading and introduction on the ivory surface.
Tablet mark and introduction fit in two columns; story retains its existing grid.
Logo follows the introduction above the story photo, with readable wordmark and clear spacing.
Narrow heading and emblem fit without horizontal scrolling.

limits: Safari and physical-device checks were not repeated for this static addition.
No image-network failure simulation or new unit tests; meaningful layout and asset checks performed.
